cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Legislative Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: This position will be instrumental in independently preparing analysis of legislation affecting the Commission, researching and responding to requests for information, and preparing testimony and correspondence related to the Commission.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Three years of professional analytical experience performing duties in one or a combination of the following or closely related areas: budgeting, management analysis, personnel, planning, program evaluation, or policy analysis.
Equivalent to graduation from college. (Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for a maximum of four years of the required education on a year-for-year basis.)
Excellent verbal, writing and critical thinking skills.
Ability to complete complex tasks with minimal supervision and within specified timeframes.
Preferred Requirements
Skill in clearly and concisely communicating sensitive and complex information to a lay audience.
Ability to coordinate disparate information from multiple sources into a cohesive whole.
Knowledge of and interest in the States' energy policies and goals, the legislative process, and legislative analysis.

Knowledge of and interest in the States' energy policies and goals, the legislative process, and legislative analysis.

You will independently lead the preparation of legislative analysis affecting the Commission, drive research and responses to information requests, and take ownership of testimony and correspondence related to the Commission.
If you are interested in [Location masked] energy policies and goals, the legislative process, and legislative analysis, we want to hear from you. This is your chance to join a small state agency with a big mission in leading the state to a 100% clean energy future.
cond_0125.responsibilities:
Lead independent preparation of analysis of legislation affecting the Commission
Drive research and responses to requests for information
Own the preparation of testimony and correspondence related to the Commission
cond_0125.requirements:
Three years of professional analytical experience performing duties in one or a combination of the following or closely related areas: budgeting, management analysis, personnel, planning, program evaluation, or policy analysis.
Equivalent to graduation from college. (Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for a maximum of four years of the required education on a year-for-year basis.)
Excellent verbal, writing and critical thinking skills.
Ability to complete complex tasks with minimal supervision and within specified timeframes.
Skill in clearly and concisely communicating sensitive and complex information to a lay audience.
Ability to coordinate disparate information from multiple sources into a cohesive whole.
Knowledge of and interest in the States' energy policies and goals, the legislative process, and legislative analysis.
cond_0125.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0125.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0420.intro:
We are looking for a Legislative Analyst to join our team. The role sits within the Office of Governmental and International Affairs and involves independently preparing analysis of legislation affecting the Commission, researching and responding to requests for information, and preparing testimony and correspondence related to the Commission.
If you are interested in [Location masked] energy policies and goals, the legislative process, and legislative analysis, we want to hear from you!
cond_0420.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Three years of professional analytical experience in one or a combination of the following or closely related areas: budgeting, management analysis, personnel, planning, program evaluation, or policy analysis.
Equivalent to graduation from college. (Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for a maximum of four years of the required education on a year-for-year basis.)
Excellent verbal, writing, and critical thinking skills.
Ability to complete complex tasks with minimal supervision and within specified timeframes.
Preferred Requirements
Skill in clearly and concisely communicating sensitive and complex information to a lay audience, including walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions directly.
Ability to actively coordinate and connect disparate information from multiple sources into a cohesive whole.
Knowledge of and interest in the state's energy policies and goals, the legislative process, and legislative analysis.

Current version of the State Examination/Employment Application (STD Form 678)
